SQL:
WITH __slayer_stage_cr AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.region_id" AS "customers__region_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.customers.regions.name" AS "customers__regions__name",
    _stage_inner."orders.customer_id" AS "customer_id",
    _stage_inner."orders.revenue" AS "revenue"
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.region_id AS "orders.customers.region_id",
      customers__regions.name AS "orders.customers.regions.name",
      orders.customer_id AS "orders.customer_id",
      CAST(SUM(orders.amount) AS DOUBLE) AS "orders.revenue"
    FROM orders AS orders
    LEFT JOIN customers AS customers
      ON orders.customer_id = customers.id
    LEFT JOIN regions AS customers__regions
      ON customers.region_id = customers__regions.id
    WHERE
      NOT customers.region_id IS NULL
    GROUP BY
      customers.region_id,
      customers__regions.name,
      orders.customer_id
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  cr.customers__region_id AS "cr.customers__region_id",
  cr.customers__regions__name AS "cr.customers__regions__name",
  cr.customer_id AS "cr.customer_id",
  cr.revenue AS "cr.revenue",
  CAST(MAX(cr.revenue) AS DOUBLE) AS "cr.mx"
FROM __slayer_stage_cr AS cr
GROUP BY
  cr.customers__region_id,
  cr.customers__regions__name,
  cr.customer_id,
  cr.revenue
ORDER BY
  "cr.customers__region_id" ASC,
  "cr.revenue" DESC
LIMIT 21

args.message: Top customer per region by revenue, where revenue is the sum of the customer's order amounts. All orders are counted, whatever their status. Customers without a region are excluded. There were no ties.
